ABOUT THE PRODUCT

Non-Woven Cleaning Cloth – Rolls.

We produce non-woven cleaning cloth in our own plant and supply it to manufacturers of cleaning cloths, floor cloths and mops as rolls slit to the required width.

The cloths are produced in grammages from 80 g/m² to 320 g/m² with viscose–polyester ratios from 20% to 80%. Plain-coloured, printed (floral, droplet, tartan and rainbow patterns), embossed and 30% microfibre options are available.

Rolls are slit to widths from 27 cm to 210 cm as required; roll length is usually 300 m. Grammage, colour, pattern and size are agreed together according to your needs.

  • 80–320 g/m² grammage
  • 20–80% viscose content
  • Plain, printed and microfibre
  • 27–210 cm roll width
